mcp.name: ai.com.mcp/linkedin
mcp.description: LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content. Powered by HAPI MCP.

profile_text.body:
LinkedIn describes itself as a professional networking service with 1 billion members, where people manage their professional identity, build and engage with a professional network, and access knowledge, insights and opportunities. The site highlights features such as Open To Work, which lets members tell recruiters privately or share publicly that they are looking for new opportunities, direct messaging to people they know, and formats including live videos, stories and newsletters for following discussions in an industry. The company profile lists LinkedIn as a for-profit founded in 2003 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, United States.

On the AI tooling side, an MCP server listed as ai.com.mcp/linkedin is described as exposing the LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content, and as powered by HAPI MCP. No separate AI products are named in the material.

Legal exposure data associates LinkedIn with 270 matters in California. No individual cases are named.
